title: Chandrayaan-2 CLASS (Chandrayaan-2 Large Area Soft X-ray Spectrometer)
description: CLASS is an X-ray fluorescence spectrometer on Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter mapping the elemental abundances of major and minor rock-forming elements (Mg, Al, Si, Ca, Ti, Fe, Na, Cr, Mn, and, during strong solar flares, P and K) on the lunar surface, using the simultaneous X-ray Solar Monitor (XSM) to calibrate the incident solar spectrum.
